cases.task: Write two concise operator-facing sentences: interactive work has queue priority, but it cannot interrupt a live accelerator lease.
cases.draft: Interactive jobs are always most important and can interrupt experiments. The coordinator handles jobs.

cases.task: Explain the difference between a durable checkpoint and a warm cache in exactly two clear sentences.
cases.draft: A checkpoint and cache both help restarts. A cache is durable unless it disappears, while checkpoints are usually cached.

cases.task: Briefly explain why exact-match replacement is a safe initial mechanism while acknowledging ambiguity and failure when the target is absent or repeated.
